lines.text: Suit: ironed. CV: printed. Traffic: checked. Alarm: two alarms.
You look like a soldier before a battle.
That's exactly how I feel.
Good morning. You're early!
Good morning. I'm Adam Fares. I have an interview at ten with Ms. Nadia.
Adam? I remember you.
Good morning, Ms. Nadia. Thank you for giving me a second chance.
So, tell me about yourself.

I'm a commerce graduate from Cairo University. I enjoy helping people and solving problems. Recently, I finished a course in customer service, and I practice my English every day. I believe this job is a great opportunity for me to grow.
Why do you want to work with us?
BlueLine helps thousands of customers every day, and you're known for great service. I want to be part of a team that makes customers happy.
How do you handle stress?
That's a good question. When I feel stressed, I take a deep breath and focus on one problem at a time. For example, during my final exams, I made a study plan, and it helped me a lot.
Adam, you're a different person from last time. What happened?
I learned from my mistakes.
"Dear Ms. Nadia, thank you for your time today. I really enjoyed our conversation, and I am very interested in this position. Best regards, Adam Fares." Send.
A thank-you email? Fancy!
Sami says it makes a good impression.
So now what?
Now… we wait.

choice.q: When does Adam arrive this time?
What does Lina say he looks like?

options: he takes a deep breath and focuses on one problem

choice.q: What does Adam send in the evening?

questions.q: What does Adam prepare the night before the interview?
questions.a: He irons his suit, prints his CV, checks the traffic, and sets two alarms.

questions.q: Why does Lina say he looks like a soldier?
questions.a: Because he is very serious and ready, like a soldier before a battle.

questions.q: How is Adam's answer about stress different this time?
questions.a: He listens to the question, stays calm, and gives an example.

questions.q: Why does Nadia say Adam is "a different person"?
questions.a: Because he is prepared, calm, and confident this time.

questions.q: Why does Adam send a thank-you email?
questions.a: Because it makes a good impression.

questions.q: Why do you want your dream job? Answer like you are in an interview.
questions.a: Example: I want to be a nurse because I enjoy helping people, and I believe it is a great opportunity to grow.
